style: Read this aloud as a warm, friendly, genuinely human guide showing one business owner around their software, like a helpful friend who is a little excited to show them something. Relaxed but lively pace, natural, a smile in the voice, gentle emphasis. Not salesy, not robotic. Say only the words below.

lines: Here is the whole platform in under two minutes, recorded live in the real app.
Every business you run gets its own business workspace: its own goal, workflows, prospects and website.
And it all runs on the server every five minutes, even with this page closed.

One click, and AI re-optimises it, in the business’s own voice.
Nothing changes until you approve it.
Or talk it through in the live chat. It asks about your business, and suggests what to try.
AI Prospecting: say who you sell to, in one sentence.
It searches live, reads each website, and checks every address before you send.
Websites and funnels for every client, built and hosted in the app.
Start from a whole site, not a blank page, and make it yours.
Stack up to three codes for more business workspaces, workflows, AI requests and client accounts.
